findings.origin: A0

No repository change required; retained with the disproof attached. Post-D-024 (2026-10-28): the 'cd *' allow no longer exists; the orchestrator carries no shell allowlist. findings.origin: A1
findings.root_cause: The global rule set is allow-all for shell (opencode.jsonc:17) followed by a denylist of prefix-anchored command strings. findings.evidence: 18 probes added to the repository's own evaluator: RESULT: FAIL (12 probe failures, 0 schema problems). Ungated with match [shell:* -> allow]: git push origin --force main, git push origin --delete feature-x, git push origin :feature-x, git push origin --mirror, git switch main, git checkout main, git checkout HEAD -- app/lib/main.dart, git stash, git tag -d v1, git -c core.pager=cat push --force origin main.
